This website provides the companion material for the paper *Likes or Dislikes, Gratifications or Concerns? A One-Week Field Experiment Analyzing the Effects of Popularity Cues on the Privacy Calculus in Online Communication*.

::: {.callout-note icon="false"}
Preregistered one-week field experiment ($N$ = 590) with like and dislike buttons on a discussion website.
:::

The analyses pages contain the detailed code and summaries of the analyses reported in the paper, as well as additional analyses not reported in the paper. This website is produced directly from the project's [github repository](https://github.com/XMtRa/like_dislike/tree/main). You can download the material and the data, file an issue, or submit a pull request.
